changes: First Modwerk release for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, on Core 2.1. Each enabled audio step remembers its own pitch increment between visits.
Positive values climb, negative values descend, and the pitch wraps back to the original note at the chosen range.
Now listed as incompatible with Digi Poly, which changes the same firmware code. The builder already refused this pair.
